title: Little Silvermoon
wikitext:
[[File:Little Silvermoon.png|thumb|300px]]
'''Little Silvermoon''', formerly known as the '''[[Cut-Throat Alley]]''', is a back alley in the [[Dwarven District]] of [[Stormwind City]] that currently houses [[High elf|high elven]] refugees that have fled the destruction of Quel'Thalas. The street was granted to the high elven refugees on behalf of the House of Nobles.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|5|A New Place in Stormwind}} ''([https://database.turtle-wow.org/?quest=80220 Deprecated])''</ref><ref>{{questlong|Alliance|10|Thalassian Diplomacy}}</ref>
